hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I saw her there, alone in the dim light of the tallow candle. I couldn't help but notice how her gown clung to her slender frame. The cold linen of my nightgown feels nothing compared to the warmth of her. I whispered to myself, wondering if she would make a good companion.
caption:
Caught in the act of my new maid lacing up her corset. 🤔
